pages.title: Direct audio URLs
pages.text: Use + Add audio in Library, then Direct audio URL.$(br2)This advanced option appears only when the server permits remote audio. Upload permission is separate.

pages.title: Add to Library
pages.text: Enter a public MP3/WAV file URL and an optional name.$(br2)Select Add to Library. Importing does not play audio; use the normal Library actions afterward.

pages.title: Saved links
pages.text: Links save in your own server-side Library.$(br2)Removing a link keeps saved playlists and running playback. Each listener connects to the URL when it plays.

pages.title: Supported sources
pages.text: URLs accept up to 256 characters. YouTube and Spotify page links are not supported.$(br2)Private and loopback addresses are blocked.

pages.title: Stream limits
pages.text: Unknown-duration streams cannot seek or serve as announcements.$(br2)Their comparator output is 7 while playing.
